text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, climbing the slope for the second time into the third corner!
It's grueling, but the real battle starts here!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: *huff, puff, pant, haaaaah*!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em, Diamond-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Goooo, Kitasan!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black, Satono Diamond!
The winner of the battle between the top two is... Satono Diamond!
(WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...Amazing... What a fierce run...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, goosebumps...!
It sent shivers right down my spine...!

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh…… Well done, you two……!
That was a great run……!!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ha... Ahaha! Nicely done, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: *huff, puff*... Hehehe, my heart's still pounding like crazy...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I... *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, if I lost running like that,
there's no helping it! It's my total defeat today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was only able to win thanks to you, Kita-chan!
Because you pulled me forward,
I was able to push past my limits.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I run with Kita-chan,
I feel like I can keep getting stronger and stronger!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Same goes for me!
Let's keep running all the way to the top together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, the top, huh~!
You sure make it sound easy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Do you even know who's standing at the top, Kita-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: T-Teio-san!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Even McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I reign at the very top!
If you wanna stand here, you'll have to beat the great Teio-sama!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Teio-san, you have taken this joking too far.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Consider this a declaration of war!! McQueen and I will be running in the autumn races!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"You're aiming for the top, right?!
Then try beating us first!"

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~~k!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you really going to race!?
According to the schedule... Why so suddenly...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, under the initial plan, entering the race wasn't being considered.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, after watching Satono-san and Kita-san's race, I had a change of heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I want to try racing against you all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"The way the two of you ran
set our hearts ablaze."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Well, then?
Will you accept our challenge?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! I'm honored!!
I would love to, please!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Me too!
Looking forward to working with you!!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm running in the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "I shall be waiting for the two of you at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm so excited! It's been so long since my last Twinkle Series race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now then, please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan...!
This isn't a dream, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...Then again, there's always the chance
Kita-chan and I are sharing the same dream...
choice_data_list: I heard it too, so it wasn't a dream.
I heard it too, so it wasn't a dream.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah!! It's not a dream!
I get to run with Teio-san!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
On the Twinkle Series stage
with McQueen-san...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy... To think a day like this would come...

Satono Diamond's eyes welled with tears,
trembling with deep emotion. Kitasan Black was the same.
They enrolled in Tracen Academy out of admiration for Mejiro McQueen and Tokai Teio respectively, so it's no wonder.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm running both the Tenno Sho (Autumn)
and the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We'd already planned on the Senior Autumn Triple Crown route.
What about you, Dia-chan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
I want to challenge McQueen-san!!
In that case, summer camp will fall in between. Considering that training under the scorching sun doesn't suit her skin...

Going into the big race cold right after summer felt risky.
It seemed best to run one prep race before the Tenno Sho (Autumn) to check her condition.
choice_data_list: Before that, let's enter the Kyoto Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "So we will make thorough adjustments based on the condition shown in the Kyoto Daishoten. I have no objections."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"If I get selected in the fan vote, it's the
Takarazuka Kinen, and then the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's both do our best for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)
so we can beat McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hoo... I still feel like I'm dreaming...
choice_data_list: It's gradually starting to feel real.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But I cannot afford to get carried away.
Not when I've been given such a wonderful opportunity to compete with McQueen-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san and Teio-san
are both legendary Umamusume
who have achieved so much already.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to learn from the two of you
and think about what a "great Umamusume" should be.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san in particular carries the name of the Mejiro family,
so she is in a position quite similar to mine.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: As a representative of the Satono family, what kind of "legendary Umamusume" should I strive to become—
choice_data_list: I'm always here if you need someone to talk to.

text_block_list.text: We promised to make her dream of 'becoming a distinguished Umamusume capable of winning a G1' come true together.

"There isn't much I can do for her future as a Trainer,
but I want to help her as much as possible."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm counting on you♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...If I can beat McQueen-san—

If you can defeat the "great Umamusume" Mejiro McQueen,
it's fair to say your ability is on par with a "great Umamusume."

The day the Satono family's long-cherished wish comes true is near—
thinking of the words she swallowed down
straightened my spine all the more.

First is the Kyoto Daishoten.
I cannot afford to stumble in a prep race.
